lessons_used: Post-adoption/certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sign-in reorders and sync hints showed no clear effect.

Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and certain visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts and story scroll narrative redesigns hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and background activity displays showed no clear effect.

Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption review flows, ownership guarantees, and layout customization showed no clear effect.

Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while mascot greetings, docking hints, retrieval callouts, and welcome stage redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide, story scroll redesign).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a stage layout with live asset preview integration.
candidates.why: Support received 3 tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong, and adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 68.9%.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated verification screen right before onboarding completion to confirm pet desktop rendering and position.
candidates.why: Support reported multiple complaints of pets missing from the desktop, and the finish step has a high mean duration of 5815s.

new_desktop_verify.headline: Verify Desktop Pet Placement
new_desktop_verify.body: Confirm your companion appears clearly on your desktop screen before continuing.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen at finish step adds severe friction, matching historical -14.4% failure.

candidates.title: Path Selection Stage Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen using a prominent stage layout that replaces standard path selection options with visual choice cards.
candidates.why: Path selection has an 87.0% conversion rate with a long mean duration (514s), suggesting user uncertainty about choices.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Multi-Step Photo Quality Inspection Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a split-layout photo inspection flow with real-time feedback and photo tips during upload.
candidates.why: 3 support emails specifically reported custom pet creation issues or incorrect pet appearances.

components.text: Use clear lighting for best custom pet generation

guard.reason: Adding photo quality inspection tips and progress inside the photo upload step is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeting high drop-off adoption with multi-step flows historically hurts completion (-5.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Delivery Progress Stage Indicator
candidates.change: Add detailed progress tracking and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop assets render.
candidates.why: Home waiting median duration is 201s (mean 2336s); progress visibility reassures users while assets download.

waiting.hint: Preparing companion graphics for your desktop...

guard.reason: Adding progress tracking and estimates on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Progress stage indicators and waiting room info reliably improve retention during long downloads.

candidates.title: Account Sync & Pet Recovery Notification Banner
candidates.change: Display a explicit account recovery hint explaining that signing in safeguards companion data across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the single largest theme) reported lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet data so companions are never lost across device sign-ins.

guard.reason: Adding an account recovery hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses top support issue (8 mails) with sync banners that worked in earlier tests.

candidates.title: Home Welcome Split Screen Showcase
candidates.change: Change the home intro screen layout to split view featuring pet welcome graphics and completion confirmation.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 24.6% with extremely high mean time (5815s); clean structure helps users complete setup.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop-off is high; split layout structural refresh provides moderate positive lift.

candidates.title: Starter Pet Companion Badge Prompt
candidates.change: Add an incentive badge to the path selection screen highlighting instant companion unlocks.
candidates.why: 13.0% of users drop off at choose_path within a median of 8s; visible perks encourage progression.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy must not mention gifts, discounts, or free extras like exclusive unlocks.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Add a reassurance hint on the adoption certificate screen promising multi-device account preservation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (31.1% abandon) and account pet loss was reported 8 times in support.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your adoption certificate and pet traits are linked to your profile automatically.

guard.reason: Adding a reassurance hint on the adoption certificate screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence and high impact step, but adoption hints and banners historically perform poorly (-5.0%).

candidates.title: Seamless Account Restore Headline Refresh
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly state pet restoration and cross-device syncing.
candidates.why: Clear sign-in messaging addresses user confusion around missing pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Keep your desktop pets safe and synchronized across all your devices seamlessly.

guard.reason: Updating text on the sign-in screen to explain sync functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Account recovery copy updates have strong historic win rate (+4.2%) addressing key support theme.

picked: Desktop Pet Delivery Progress Stage Indicator

decisions.title: Desktop Pet Delivery Progress Stage Indicator

lessons_next: Post-adoption/certificate sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won, while moving sign-in post-waiting hurt and sync hints/notices showed no clear effect.

Headline clarity updates, spotlight layouts, and story stage visual redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while value refreshes and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and desktop spawn hints won; 3D trackers, completion timers, progress indicators, and sound notifications showed no clear effect.

Split upload companion previews paired with photo quality guides won; compact grids, multi-step quality inspection/fallback flows, guidelines banners, and stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption reviews showed no clear effect.

Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome stage redesigns and retrieval callouts had no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., placement verification screens, interactive spawn flows) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, multi-step quality inspection flows).
